description: This file defines the MessagePath interface, representing the 'path' field in Ditto protocol messages, providing methods to retrieve feature IDs and directions, as well as static utilities for mapping between JSON keys and message directions.

classes.name: MessagePath
classes.description: An interface extending JsonPointer that models the 'path' component in Ditto protocol messages, including optional methods to get feature ID and message direction, along with static utility methods for JSON key to direction conversions.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature ID if available, or an empty Optional if not.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the MessageDirection (TO or FROM), if specified.

methods.name: jsonKeyToDirection
methods.description: Converts a JsonKey to an Optional MessageDirection based on its string representation ('inbox' or 'outbox').

methods.name: directionToJsonKey
methods.description: Converts a MessageDirection (TO or FROM) to its corresponding JsonKey ('inbox' or 'outbox').
